conventions.result: published final outcome from white perspective: 1 white win, 0 draw, -1 black win
conventions.sample: position BEFORE human move; entire rejected games contribute zero samples
conventions.gameId: SHA256(year + newline + newline-normalized trimmed full PDN game block)
conventions.notation: PDN squares 1..32 converted to referee indices 0..31

limitations: Public download is not an identified open license; no claim of permission to redistribute the corpus.
Human results can reflect resignation or agreed draws; a nonterminal final board is allowed.
Ambiguous capture paths, unsupported tokens/setup, unknown or inconsistent results are rejected, never guessed.
No statistical independence claim for positions from the same game or repeated openings.
Replay uses current Dama.Engine rules, not an independently certified historical referee.
